title: Jesus... Why Do I Feel Like A Fraud On My First Day?
topic: impostor fear the night before his first day at a new job

bible.text: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... everyone congratulated me on the new job. I said "thanks" and felt like a fraud. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if they find out in week one I'm not good enough?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You read their docs past midnight. I led you there for a reason.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if I freeze when they ask me something?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then say: let me check and get back to you. They all had a first day.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Walk in slowly. They picked you, and I went ahead of you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend starting something new this week. 🙏
